answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 162566 Country: india Title: If any imam does not recite Fajr prayer with or without jamat, and we are allowed to perform other namaz as Zuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha behind him? Question: If any imam does not recite Fajr prayer with or without jamat, and we are allowed to perform other namaz as Zuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha behind him? Answer ID: 162566 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1043/906/B=11/1439) If he does so without any Shariah uzr (excuse) merely due to negligence and carelessness and he has become habitual of it then such imam at first be convinced if he abides then it is better, but if he does not and continues missing Fajr jamat then praying salah behind him will be makrooh tahrimi. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
